prior_arm64_packaging.qualification: Separate E ARM64 packaging gate; all runtime source/build inputs in source.production_inputs are unchanged in F. No new F ARM64 run is claimed.

history.qualification: E failed restoring a transient setup HOME holder after 12 navigation observations; notifications/SMS/Telecom device credits remain zero.
Earlier active-call acceptance failure remains unresolved; later passes and the separate E HOME failure do not retroactively establish its cause.

limitations: Runtime evidence is from an API36 x86_64 software-GPU emulator, not physical ARM64/OEM hardware.
Incoming SMS/call and remote hangup were emulator fixtures; the app Answer button and real Android Telecom/service/notification state were observed.
The MMS codec exercise reports zero RF requests; no carrier delivery, RF behavior, outgoing paid call or real-world emergency-call behavior was validated.
GSM console lists are diagnostic only; real Telecom transitions and strict native observations establish the call lifecycle.
Android HOME ownership is a launcher role and does not confer Android system-shell ownership.
Screenshots validate this implementation on the test device; they do not establish exact original Windows Phone visual parity.

publication_retention.qualification: Original ZIPs and all-file manifests are indexed above. These selected unmodified Android originals are retained with exact artifact-entry mappings; temporary local paths identify the verification workspace.
